title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the People's Bank of China, and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission on Issuing the Opinions on Comprehensively Advancing the Construction of a Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Financial Disputes
keywords_en: Regarding the Comprehensive Promotion of Financial Dispute Resolution
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court
People's Bank of China
China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission

Notice on Issuing the Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Financial Disputes

Fa Fa [2019] No. 27

To: the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the Shanghai Headquarters, all branches, business management departments, provincial capital (capital city) sub-branches, and sub-provincial city sub-branches of the People's Bank of China; all banking and insurance regulatory bureaus; the China Development Bank, all policy banks, state-owned commercial banks, joint-stock banks, the Postal Savings Bank of China, foreign banks, all non-bank payment institutions, and all financial dispute mediation organizations:

The Opinions of the Supreme People's Court, the People's Bank of China, and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Financial Disputes are hereby issued to you for earnest implementation.

November 19, 2019

Opinions on Comprehensively Promoting the Construction of a Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Financial Disputes

Promoting the construction of a diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes is an important measure to smooth the channels for financial consumers to seek rights relief, meet the growing judicial and financial needs of the people, prevent and resolve financial risks, and fully leverage the functional roles of the people's courts and financial regulatory authorities in the modernization of the national governance system and governance capacity. To implement the Opinions of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council on Improving the Diversified Resolution Mechanism for Conflicts and Disputes, the Guiding Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Strengthening the Protection of Financial Consumers' Rights and Interests, and the Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Further Deepening the Reform of the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism by the People's Courts, the following opinions are hereby put forward on comprehensively deepening the construction of a diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes:

I. Work Objectives

1. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, fully implement the spirit of the 19th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Second, Third, and Fourth Plenary Sessions of the 19th Central Committee, adhere to the Party's absolute leadership over judicial work and financial work, adhere to placing non-litigation dispute resolution mechanisms in the forefront, establish and improve a professional, efficient, organically linked, convenient and beneficial diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes, rationally allocate dispute resolution resources, protect the legitimate rights and interests of financial consumers, promote the sustained and healthy development of the financial industry, and comprehensively enhance the people's sense of gain, happiness, and security.

II. Work Principles

2. Principle of Lawfulness and Impartiality. The diversified resolution of financial disputes shall not violate the basic principles of law, nor harm the national interest, collective interest, or the legitimate rights and interests of third parties.

Principle of Voluntary Mediation. Fully respect the will of all parties involved, and guarantee that the parties exercise their civil rights and litigation rights in accordance with the law.

Principle of Efficiency and Convenience. Based on the actual circumstances of financial disputes, flexibly determine dispute resolution methods, strengthen the in-depth application of information technology, improve dispute resolution efficiency, and reduce the cost of dispute resolution for the parties.

III. Work Content

(A) Strengthen Division of Labor and Collaboration

3. People's courts at all levels shall give full play to their judicial functions, and in the overall work of vigorously promoting the construction of a diversified dispute resolution mechanism and a modern litigation service system, achieving one-stop dispute resolution and one-stop litigation services, solidly advance the diversified resolution of financial disputes. The People's Bank of China and its branches, together with the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission and its派出 agencies, shall formulate overall and local plans for the development of financial dispute mediation organizations, and promote the construction of a non-litigation third-party resolution mechanism for financial disputes. People's courts at all levels, together with the People's Bank of China and its branches and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission and its派出 agencies (hereinafter referred to as financial regulatory authorities), shall actively integrate into the construction of a诉源 governance mechanism led by the Party committee and government, strengthen communication and coordination with relevant departments, and solve difficulties in the construction of a diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes.

(B) Strengthen the Construction of Financial Dispute Mediation Organizations

4. Establish and improve financial dispute mediation organizations. Financial regulatory authorities, acting as business guidance units, shall promote the establishment and improvement of a financial dispute mediation organization system that is wide in coverage, highly adaptable, efficient, and convenient for the people. Encourage financial regulatory authorities and financial institutions to provide necessary office space and personnel support for financial dispute mediation organizations. Financial dispute mediation organizations shall focus on optimizing governance structures and establishing rules and regulations to enhance service efficiency.

5. Strengthen the construction of the mediator team and funding guarantees. Financial dispute mediation organizations shall establish and improve mechanisms for the selection, certification, assessment, reward and punishment, and withdrawal of mediators. Mediators shall be selected based on standards of neutrality, impartiality, and professionalism. A team of mediators combining full-time and part-time members shall be established, and a pool of mediation experts shall be formed. Strengthen training on mediators' political awareness, professional ethics, mediation skills, and legal and financial knowledge. Mediators shall strictly abide by the confidentiality requirements of mediation and shall not illegally disclose to any third party the case information obtained during the performance of their duties. Establish a funding guarantee mechanism. The subsidies for mediators handling cases shall cover expenses such as loss of time, meals, and transportation.

6. Explore the establishment of a fast-track dispute resolution mechanism for small claims. Encourage financial dispute mediation organizations to introduce a fast-track dispute resolution mechanism for small claims by signing memoranda or agreements with financial institutions. For financial disputes involving a compensation amount within a certain limit, mediators may, in accordance with laws, administrative regulations, judicial interpretations, and industry practices, and based on the principles of fairness and impartiality, propose a dispute resolution opinion. If the financial consumer accepts the opinion, all parties to the dispute shall accept and undertake to perform the mediation opinion. If the financial consumer does not accept the opinion, the mediation opinion shall have no binding force on any party and shall serve as an expert opinion for the parties' reference. Financial dispute mediation organizations shall evaluate the effectiveness of the fast-track dispute resolution mechanism for small claims and timely adjust the applicable amount range and business areas.

7. Establish a neutral evaluation mechanism. For financial disputes with significant controversy or typical characteristics, financial dispute mediation organizations may engage independent experts with no conflict of interest to produce an advisory evaluation report based on a comprehensive consideration of the statements and evidence submitted by all parties, for the parties' reference. When financial institutions handle difficult or complex complaints, they may apply to the mediation organization to assign an independent expert to issue a neutral evaluation opinion on the financial consumer dispute, and use the neutral evaluation opinion as a reference to negotiate a resolution plan with the complainant.

8. Promote the establishment of "one-stop" financial dispute resolution institutions. Promote financial dispute mediation organizations to provide "complaint + mediation + adjudication" one-stop dispute resolution services. Based on existing financial dispute mediation organizations, explore the establishment of professional financial dispute resolution institutions independent of financial regulatory authorities, to enhance the availability and convenience of financial complaint channels. Professional financial dispute resolution institutions shall assume functions such as complaint acceptance, transfer, mediation, and adjudication, promote efficient dispute resolution, and effectively reduce the burden on the parties.

(C) Standardize Work Procedures

9. Improve the litigation-mediation platform and the roster system for specially invited mediation organizations and specially invited mediators. People's courts at all levels shall effectively leverage the role of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism, and integrate the construction of the diversified dispute resolution mechanism with the construction of the litigation service center. Introduce financial dispute mediation organizations and mediators into litigation service centers. Regions with conditions shall actively establish financial dispute mediation rooms for the work of specially invited mediation organizations and specially invited mediators for financial disputes. Establish and dynamically manage the roster of specially invited mediation organizations and the roster of specially invited mediators, providing complete and accurate information on mediation organizations and mediators to parties in financial disputes. Explore the invitation of mediators from financial dispute mediation organizations to serve as people's jurors, enhancing the professional level of trials. People's courts and financial dispute mediation organizations may establish mutual workstations to strengthen two-way connection and enhance the convenience and benefit of mediation services for the people.

10. Clarify the scope of cases. Contract and tort liability disputes arising from financial business between equal civil and commercial subjects may apply to financial dispute mediation organizations for mediation.

11. Implement referral and entrustment mediation. When accepting and hearing financial dispute cases, people's courts shall implement the policy of "mediation first, combining mediation with adjudication." For cases with a mediation basis, in accordance with the principles of voluntariness and legality, adopt methods such as referral mediation before case filing, entrustment mediation after case filing, and invitation to mediate during litigation, to guide the parties to resolve disputes through financial dispute mediation organizations.

When a people's court refers or entrusts mediation, it shall send a letter of referral or entrustment for mediation to the financial dispute mediation organization, and transfer the relevant case materials to the financial dispute mediation organization. Encourage parties to submit mediation applications through the People's Court Mediation Platform (hereinafter referred to as the court mediation platform). The people's court shall refer or entrust mediation cases to the financial dispute mediation organization through the court mediation platform. The financial dispute mediation organization shall log in to online mediation platforms such as the "China Financial Consumer Dispute Mediation Network" (www.fcosc.org) to accept referrals and entrustments and carry out mediation work.

12. Organize mediation. When a financial dispute mediation organization and its mediators organize mediation and all parties reach a consensus, the financial dispute mediation organization shall prepare a mediation agreement, signed by the mediator and all parties. For cases referred or entrusted by a people's court, the financial dispute mediation organization shall promptly submit the mediation result and relevant documents in writing or through a work platform recognized by all parties to the referring or entrusting court.

If mediation is unsuccessful, the financial dispute mediation organization shall inform all parties that they may resolve the dispute through arbitration, litigation, or other channels. For cases referred or entrusted by a people's court, the financial dispute mediation organization shall promptly reply to the people's court, and the people's court shall, in accordance with relevant regulations, promptly register the case for filing or resume the trial.

13. Strictly adhere to mediation time limits. For financial dispute cases referred for mediation by a people's court, the mediation period is 30 days; this limit does not apply if all parties agree to extend the mediation period.

For financial dispute cases entrusted for mediation by a people's court, the mediation period for cases applying ordinary procedures is 15 days, and for cases applying summary procedures is 7 days; this limit does not apply if all parties agree to extend the mediation period; the extended mediation period shall not be counted in the trial period.

The period for referral mediation and entrustment mediation shall be calculated from the date on which the financial dispute mediation organization signs for the materials transferred by the court.

14. Apply for judicial confirmation. Mediation agreements reached through mediation presided over by a mediator of a financial dispute mediation organization have the nature of a civil contract. After being signed and sealed by the mediator and the financial dispute mediation organization, the parties may apply to a competent people's court for confirmation of their validity. For mediation agreements reached through referral mediation by a people's court, and the parties apply for judicial confirmation, the case shall be accepted by the referring people's court in accordance with the law. People's courts may conduct online judicial confirmation of mediation agreements through the court mediation platform.

If one party refuses to perform a mediation agreement that has been confirmed valid by a people's court and has clear subjects and content of performance, the other party may apply to the people's court for compulsory enforcement.

15. Fully utilize online dispute resolution methods to carry out work. Continuously enrich and improve the functions of online mediation platforms such as the "China Financial Consumer Dispute Mediation Network" (www.fcosc.org). Promote the establishment of a "head-to-head" online litigation-mediation connection mechanism for financial disputes through data exchange and interconnection between the platform and the court mediation platform. Actively explore the use of information technology to improve the efficiency of specific tasks such as referral and entrustment of mediation, service of documents, exchange of case materials, and judicial confirmation of mediation agreements, facilitating the participation of parties in the diversified resolution of financial disputes. Financial dispute mediation organizations shall fully utilize technical means to build a mediation system encompassing online mediation, onsite mediation, telephone mediation, and other channels, to efficiently and timely resolve disputes. Formulate and improve online dispute resolution rules, and summarize and promote practical experiences such as remote mediation. Financial dispute mediation organizations shall strengthen the configuration of hardware facilities, record audio and video of the mediation process, and ensure full traceability of the mediation process; when a people's court needs to access relevant audio and video materials during the judicial confirmation process, the financial dispute mediation organization shall actively cooperate.

(D) Improve Guarantee Mechanisms

16. Enhance the informatization level of financial dispute resolution. Establish and improve the typical case database for financial disputes and the financial complaint database. Deepen the sharing of judicial and financial information. Give full play to the positive role of smart court and smart finance construction in the diversified resolution of financial disputes.

17. Increase support for the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Financial institutions shall designate specific departments to promote the diversified resolution of financial disputes, and incorporate the diversified resolution of financial disputes into the performance evaluation of the unit's financial consumer rights protection work. When a financial consumer applies for mediation to resolve a dispute, the financial institution shall actively participate in the mediation and cooperate with the people's court and financial dispute mediation organization in ascertaining the facts. Financial regulatory authorities shall include the mediation closure rate of financial disputes in the assessment and evaluation system for financial institutions' consumer protection, guiding financial institutions to strengthen the awareness of "mediating whenever possible." For financial institutions that refuse to perform a mediation agreement that has been reached without justifiable reasons, the financial regulatory authorities and financial dispute mediation organizations may disclose such information through complaint situation analysis reports, financial dispute mediation operation reports, and other means.

IV. Work Requirements

18. Establish working groups. Local people's courts at all levels, branches of the People's Bank of China at all levels, dispatched agencies of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission at all levels, and local financial dispute mediation organizations shall jointly establish a working group for the construction of a diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes, hold joint meetings regularly, communicate on work situations, strengthen information sharing, and coordinate the mediation of major typical financial dispute cases; assess and summarize the work of diversified resolution of financial disputes, and continuously optimize the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes; focus on jointly building a financial risk warning and prevention mechanism to prevent systemic financial risks triggered by individual cases.

19. Strengthen publicity and guidance. People's courts at all levels, financial regulatory authorities, and financial dispute mediation organizations shall, through various means such as guiding by exemplary cases, increasing publicity efforts, and strengthening financial consumer education, jointly enhance the awareness and trust of parties in financial disputes and the public in the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes, actively guide parties to resolve financial disputes through mediation, and protect rights in accordance with the law and rationally. After receiving financial consumer complaints, branches of the People's Bank of China at all levels and dispatched agencies of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission at all levels shall promptly transfer them to the complained financial institution for handling, or transfer them to a financial dispute mediation organization for mediation services.

20. Strengthen the participation and recognition of financial institutions in the construction of a diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes. Encourage financial institutions to establish mechanisms such as dynamic granting of mediation authority, cross-regional granting, timely response to mediation, and quick approval, to ensure that grassroots financial institutions can efficiently resolve financial disputes through mediation. Financial institutions shall enhance their recognition of mediation agreements. Mediation agreements reached within the scope of authorization shall serve as one of the bases for financial institutions' accounting write-offs. People's courts at all levels, financial regulatory authorities, and financial dispute mediation organizations may commend and publicize collectives and individuals that have performed outstandingly in the diversified resolution of financial disputes.

21. Hold financial institutions accountable as the primary responsible entities for handling financial disputes. By improving the level of compliance operations, optimizing financial products and services, and strengthening information disclosure in accordance with the law, reduce financial disputes at the source and enhance the level of "诉源 governance" of conflicts and disputes. Financial institutions shall display at prominent positions such as business counters and official websites the internal and external channels for handling financial consumer disputes and the contact information of local financial dispute mediation organizations. When entering into contracts with consumers, financial institutions may agree with the other party to resolve disputes through mediation.

22. Strengthen supervision, guidance, coordination, and management. The Supreme People's Court, the People's Bank of China, and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission shall establish a joint meeting system for the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes, responsible for the planning, coordination, and promotion of the construction of the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes. The Second Civil Division and the Case Filing Division of the Supreme People's Court, together with the Financial Consumer Rights Protection Bureau of the People's Bank of China and the Consumer Rights Protection Bureau of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, shall establish a working group for the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes, specifically responsible for the guidance and coordination of the construction of the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes. Each High People's Court shall guide, supervise, and inspect the people's courts within its jurisdiction in implementing the work requirements of the diversified resolution mechanism for financial disputes. Branches of the People's Bank of China at all levels and dispatched agencies of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission at all levels shall strengthen support for the diversified resolution of financial disputes, and guide and support financial dispute mediation organizations in carrying out their work. Local people's courts at all levels, branches of the People's Bank of China at all levels, and dispatched agencies of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission at all levels shall promptly report their work situations and problems encountered to the Supreme People's Court, the People's Bank of China, and the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission level by level.

November 19, 2019
